name: quick-reply
description: Reply to parts of an answer: comment on blocks inline, or quote a selection with > on an empty prompt line

tmuxEnter.title: tmux: Enter saves without scrolling
tmuxEnter.description: Inside tmux, bind Enter (in the running server, not your config) to send Shift+Enter while a comment is armed, so saving it doesn't scroll to the end. Skipped if Enter is already bound or extended-keys is off.
